{{Top|leg}}
The '''K'ghaan''' was a [[Ssi-ruuvi]] term which loosely translated to mean ''"Hidden Claw"'' and referred to a group of black scaled [[Ssi-ruu]]. These individuals were taken from their families in order to be trained as assassins and bodyguards for the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]]'s leader; His Potency the [[Shreeftut]]. They were believed to serve as the [[secret police]] for their master and worked in a similar manner as [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].
